request.spec:
A person may name other people on the sheet as their patrons, one at a time from their row (not
themselves, and not the same person twice; a refusal shows an error on the row; PATRON_ADDED
name=<name> patron=<patron name>). Show each person's patrons (names, comma and space separated,
sorted) and their backing: their patrons' due-totals added up, skipping n/a, 0.00 with no
patrons.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A person may name other people on the sheet as their patrons, one at a time from their row (not
themselves, and not the same person twice; a refusal shows an error on the row; PATRON_ADDED
name=<name> patron=<patron name>). Show each person's patrons (names, comma and space separated,
sorted) and their backing: their patrons' due-totals added up, skipping n/a, 0.00 with no
patrons.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
People can now name other people on the sheet as their patrons, one at a time from their row. Each row shows the person's patrons and their backing. `bin/e2e` passes all 4 acceptance tests.

**Stored data:** new migration `V22__person_patron.sql` adds a `person_patron` table. The database itself refuses the same patron twice and a person as their own patron.

**Server** (`person/`):
- New `Patron` record type and `PatronRepository`.
- `PersonService.addPatron` checks the request and refuses with a 409 when the patron is the person themselves or already one of their patrons. If two users add the same patron at once, the second also gets a 409. When an add goes through, it writes `PATRON_ADDED sheet=… by=… name=<name> patron=<patron name>` to the audit file. A refused add writes nothing.
- Two new endpoints: `POST /api/people/patrons/list` and `POST /api/people/patrons/add`. I kept patrons separate from the existing person data, so a person's edit version doesn't change when a patron is added.

**Front end** (`features/people/people.ts`): each row has a new Patrons column with:
- `person-patrons`: the patrons' names, sorted and separated by ", ".
- `person-backing`: the patrons' due-totals added up, skipping any that are n/a, and 0.00 with no patrons. It uses the same due-total the screen shows for each patron, so it changes when a patron is put on hold or a rate changes.
- `person-patron-select`, which lists everyone on the sheet, and an `person-patron-add` button.
- `person-patron-error`, shown when an add is refused. It clears when the selection changes or when the next action on that row is taken.

The screen refuses yourself or a duplicate before calling the server, and the server checks again.
